title: Quant profile orchestration and stability sentinel for Hopper FP8 (E4M3/E5M2)
creator: Maya Chen
description: Enable FP8 quantization profiles for Hopper (E4M3/E5M2) with an orchestration layer that chooses profiles per-model and per-shard, plus a stability sentinel to detect activation regressions and automate safe rollbacks. Acceptance criteria: 1) selector picks E4M3/E5M2 per-model with >=99% compatibility on golden test set; 2) sentinel detects drift > threshold and triggers canary downgrade/fallback within SLO; 3) automated regression harness runs nightly and surfaces failing seeds to a dashboard; 4) runbook and PRD linked and reviewed.
implementation_notes: Plan: build a lightweight selector service that consumes model metadata + recent latency/accuracy telemetry and recommends profile (E4M3/E5M2/int8). Integrate a 'stability sentinel' component that computes per-model regression scores using our golden prompts and a small stochastic sample. Add gating to rollout pipeline: shadow -> dark-launch canary mesh (5% traffic across shards) -> progressive ramp with telemetry gates (accuracy delta, token error rate, latency p95). Implement safe rollback hooks into runtime and add audit events to Kinesis. Tie release to runtime-1.20 and runtime-config flags. Calibration pipeline: use the existing calibration runner but expand sample diversity and add per-layer noise injection to catch fragile layers.
acceptance_criteria: Selector recommendations reproducible across 3 runs on golden suite
Stability sentinel raises alert when accuracy delta > 0.6% or hallucination score worsens by 1.2x
Canary mesh completes 24h smoke window with telemetry gates green before ramp
Automated rollback triggers and runbook ops tested in staging
